implementationScope: package-only resource-aware DecodedImage finalization with exact ImageProbe authority derived from the independent progressive JPEG parser and explicit fail-closed orientation/auxiliary semantics
requiredInvariants: All v4 resource-aware finalization, no-copy provider, DecodedImage geometry/color and framework-private resource facts remain unchanged.
The resource-aware finalization publishes an exact ImageProbe: 23x13, one frame, orientation 1, JPEG, zero auxiliary attachments and source profile absent.
Probe metadataByteCount must equal an independent scan of all JPEG APP0..APP15 and COM payload bytes; it is not a hard-coded fixture constant or a retained metadata buffer size.

The retained source must contain no EXIF/XMP orientation authority, MPF auxiliary authority or embedded ICC authority. Executable hostile tests prove these recognized authorities fail closed in one-shot and incremental paths before raster semantics are published.

The resource-aware capability remains package-only and the current session still does not advertise the existing public ProgressiveImageFinalizingSession while Core Graphics wrapper operation allocation is unknown.
